source: APERC FPPCA FY2022-23 Common Order in O.P.Nos.57 to 68 of 2024 (APDISCOMs fuel-cost true-up), Sec 'CGS Stations whose PPAs have the approval of the Commission', Variable Cost table p.53. Header columns: 'Variable Cost (Rs. Cr): Approved | Actual Claim' , 'Variable Cost (Rs/kWh): Approved | Actual' , '%Variance' , 'Admissible VC (Rs.Cr)'.
